module: GNK ASG Mail Agent Reply Templates

receipt_confirmation_hr.body:
Poštovani,

potvrđujemo primitak Vaše poruke. GNK ASG Digital Assistant evidentirao je upit i, ako bude potrebno, zatražit će dodatne informacije ili ga proslijediti na odgovarajući pregled.

Ako se Vaša poruka odnosi na pitanje koje zahtijeva službenu provjeru ili odluku ovlaštene osobe, sadržajni odgovor bit će dan nakon pregleda.

receipt_confirmation_en.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

we confirm receipt of your message. The GNK ASG Digital Assistant has recorded the inquiry and will request additional information or forward it for appropriate review if needed.

If your message concerns a matter requiring official review or a decision by an authorised person, a substantive response will be provided after review.

request_more_information_hr.body:
Poštovani,

kako bismo mogli smisleno obraditi Vaš upit, molimo da nam dostavite predmet upita, očekivani rok, relevantne dokumente ili poveznice te kontakt osobu za daljnju komunikaciju.

Nakon primitka dopune, upit će biti razvrstan i obrađen u skladu s njegovom naravi.

request_more_information_en.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

in order to process your inquiry properly, please provide the subject of the request, expected timeline, relevant documents or links, and the contact person for further communication.

After receiving the additional information, the inquiry will be classified and handled according to its nature.

forwarded_for_review_hr.body:
Poštovani,

Vaša poruka je zaprimljena i proslijeđena na pregled jer se odnosi na temu koja zahtijeva dodatnu provjeru prije sadržajnog odgovora.

Javit ćemo se nakon pregleda ili ćemo zatražiti dodatne informacije ako budu potrebne.

forwarded_for_review_en.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

your message has been received and forwarded for review because it concerns a subject that requires additional verification before a substantive response can be provided.

We will respond after review or request additional information if needed.

hold_for_review_rule: The agent must not autonomously send a substantive reply if the message is sensitive, unclear, binding, financially material, reputationally relevant, personal, official in nature, or outside routine business communication.
safe_autonomous_scope: meeting time proposal based on free-busy availability
notice that the inquiry has been forwarded for review
